Looking at the repository state, I see the site has achieved good parity across pages: skip-links on all pages, consistent GitHub link security, star/print/copy/report buttons everywhere, dark mode, and accessibility features. The last tick added skip-links to all 11 HTML pages.

One small but meaningful improvement: the "Last updated" badge in the footer currently only loads once on page load. Making it refresh periodically (e.g., every 60 seconds) would give visitors a real-time feel without page reloads — especially valuable since the site updates ~16 times daily.

This is a tiny, safe change in `app.js` that affects all pages uniformly.

I'll make the "Last updated" badge refresh periodically so visitors see real-time updates. Currently `initBadge()` in `app.js` only sets the badge once on page load. Adding a `setInterval` to refresh it every 60 seconds is a small, safe change that improves UFA for all 11 pages without altering any HTML structure.

Files to change:
- `site/app.js` — modify `initBadge()` to add periodic refresh
- `MEMORY.md` — append a dated note

Risk: Very low. The change is confined to the existing `initBadge()` function, adds only `setInterval` + `refreshBadge` helper, and the `node --check` syntax validation will pass since no new APIs or syntax are introduced.
